test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which mobile application was introduced by the National Commission for Women in May 2025 to enhance women’s digital literacy and safety in advanced digital tools?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yashoda Artificial Intelligence Learning App**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Commission for Women (NCW)** introduced the **Yashoda Artificial Intelligence Learning App** in **May 2025** to address the evolving needs of women in the **digital era**.
 
• The primary objective of this application is to enhance **digital literacy** and provide specialized training in **advanced digital tools**, specifically focusing on **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** applications. ***Hence, the correct answer is Yashoda Artificial Intelligence Learning App.***
 
• The app offers comprehensive modules on **Generative AI (GenAI)**, **data analytics**, and **machine learning**, tailored for women entrepreneurs, students, and professionals to bridge the **gender digital divide** in **India**.
 
• Safety is a core component of the platform, featuring advanced tools for **deepfake detection**, **cyber-harassment prevention**, and **online safety guidelines** to protect women from digital threats.
 
• The initiative aligns with the **Digital India** vision, empowering women with the skills necessary to navigate the **4th Industrial Revolution** safely and effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Commission for Women (NCW):**
 
 
• Established in **January 1992** as a **statutory body** under the **National Commission for Women Act, 1990**.
 
• The commission is mandated to review **constitutional and legal safeguards** for women, recommend remedial legislative measures, and facilitate **grievance redressal**.
 
• It operates under the **Ministry of Women and Child Development**, Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Digital Shakti Campaign:**
 
 
• Prior to the **Yashoda App**, the **NCW** launched the **Digital Shakti** campaign in **June 2018**.
 
• It was designed to make women **digitally skilled** and aware of **cyber crimes**. The campaign has seen several phases (e.g., **Digital Shakti 4.0** and **5.0**), reaching millions of women across the **country**.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Mobile Applications:**
 
 
• **Kaaval Uthavi:** A mobile application launched by the **Tamil Nadu Police** in **2022**. It is primarily an **emergency assistance tool** featuring an **SOS button** for citizens, especially women, to seek immediate police help.
 
• **Kavalan-SOS:** Another safety app integrated into the **Tamil Nadu** state police network, designed for personal safety in **distress situations**.
 
• **Digital Saathi:** Generally refers to various **NGO-led** or **UNICEF-supported** programs aimed at rural **digital empowerment**, but it is not the specific **May 2025** NCW AI initiative.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Features of the Yashoda App:**
 
 
• **Multilingual Support:** The app is available in **12 major Indian languages** to ensure inclusivity for women from diverse **geographic locations**.
 
• **Certification:** Upon completion of the learning modules, users receive a certificate recognized by the **National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)**.
 
• **AI-Based Mentor:** The app includes a **virtual AI assistant** named **Yashoda** that provides real-time guidance and answers queries related to **cybersecurity**.
 
 
 
• **Legal and Policy Context:**
 
 
• The launch of such tools is supported by **Article 15(3)** of the **Constitution of India**, which allows the State to make special provisions for **women and children**.
 
• It also complements the **Information Technology (IT) Act, 2000**, by educating users on how to report **cyber offences** through the national portal.
